verdict.rationale: Vanta's GRC page says controls can be cross-mapped across its pre-built or customized frameworks, and that customers can 'automate across multiple frameworks without extra effort.' The PCI page adds that controls are reused when adding new frameworks, and the API can filter evidence by framework, so the core of cross-framework reuse is documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the overlap is shown to the user, specific confirmation of SOC 2→ISO 27001/HIPAA mapping, any depth beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
